The '''Doashim''' of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] were fierce and aggressive creatures found in the [[Dark Ridges]] of the subterranean world. Many [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] thought they were reminiscent of demons from their own culture of origin.

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Doashim are similar in appearance to the Deathclaws of the Fallout series. It also slightly resembles the theropod dinosaur known as Carnotaurus.
